Ajay S.: FYI — we've validated the delayed token ingestion from last week. Partial batches landed late, which caused token counts to be underreported for 3 customers.
Marie (Finance): Ack. Which invoice windows are impacted? rough numbers?
Ajay S.: Affected windows: 2026-03-08 00:00 -> 2026-03-09 03:00 UTC. Magnitude: ~2-12% undercount depending on route. IDs: C-219, C-540, C-777.
Sarah L.: I can own backfill. Plan: replay batches -> generate correction ledger entries -> dry-run reconciliation. Need infra support for replay throttles.
Eli (Infra): I can add replay capacity and a temporary isolation pool. Will create a small job: `metering.replay --window=2026-03-08T00:00Z/2026-03-09T03:00Z --throttle=200r/s`.
David P.: I'll own invoice corrections and credit calculations. Need final corrected token counts and a signed off list of customers+periods.
Marie (Finance): I'll draft customer comms for impacted accounts and the credit memo template. ETA for comms depends on David's numbers.
billing-bot: metering.replay job queued id=job-5543 status=queued
Ajay S.: Action items summary:
• Sarah L. — backfill replay + dry-run by 03/24 end of day.
• Eli (Infra) — provisioning + throttle controls (infrastructure) by 03/23 EOD.
• David P. — prepare invoice corrections and credit calc, send draft by 03/25.
• Marie (Finance) — customer comms draft by 03/26.
• Ajay S. — coordinate canary checks and final signoff.
Sarah L.: Quick note: need an allowlist for the replay to avoid double-billing any already-run reconciles. @Eli can you add a safe-mode flag?
Eli (Infra): yes. adding `--safe-mode` to skip ledgers marked reconciled; ETA 2 hours.
David P.: For the credits, do we use formula: corrected_tokens - billed_tokens => credit at published rate? Any rounding rules?
Marie (Finance): Use published rate, round to nearest cent, include a minimum goodwill credit of $5 if correction < $5.
Ajay S.: Also flag: recurrence check. This was caused by a regression in the batching window logic due to DST edge-case in the windowing code. We'll add a monitoring alert to detect >1% per-hour delta vs expected ingestion. @Eli to add.
Eli (Infra): Adding metric `metering.ingest.window_drift_pct` and alert `>=1.0` sustained 5m. Will post config once done.
Sarah L.: I'll run the dry-run and paste reconciliation summary here when ready.
billing-bot: metering.replay job job-5543 status=running progress=12%
Ajay S.: Thanks all. Let's sync in the 11am ops standup tomorrow, but prefer async updates here. :thumbsup:
David P.: noted — I'll post the first draft of credits spreadsheet here by 03/25 16:00 UTC.
Sarah L.: dry-run done — summary: ledger diffs match expectations, highest delta 11.7% (C-540). Uploading artifacts: s3://redwood-metering/backfills/1987654321/dryrun.tar.gz
Marie (Finance): got it, prepping comms. Will attach sample email and CC list.
Ajay S.: Closing loop: owners confirm and keep updates here. If anything slips, escalate to #eng-sre. :eyes:
